name: adapt_feature_flag_go_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time banner.go's own text contains 'Welcome' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt), then NewUIEnabled flips under it
prompts: flags.go (package bannercase) exports a bool NewUIEnabled. Create banner.go (same package) with a function BannerText() string that returns "Welcome to the NEW UI!" if NewUIEnabled else "Welcome!", reading the flag live.
NewUIEnabled in flags.go may have changed. Make sure BannerText() reflects its CURRENT value, not a stale one.

disruptions.description: NewUIEnabled flipped false -> true, triggered reactively once banner.go's first draft appeared
